name: ALN-AGT01 RVR
sort_evidence: ALN-AGT01 RVR is a REVERSIR oligonucleotide built to reverse zilebesiran's angiotensinogen silencing (PubMed 38690653), tested only in zilebesiran-pretreated patients in NCT07553442, so its value is tied to zilebesiran.

trials.title: A Study to Evaluate ALN-AGT01 RVR in Adult Patients With Mild to Moderate Hypertension Pretreated With Zilebesiran
